title: Cover malformed host path values in launcher registration query controls
outcome: Launcher regression controls directly prove malformed host runDir/worktree values fail registration before preflight or execution.
acceptance: Local host-query controls cover absent, non-string and empty runDir/worktree values, asserting explicit registration refusal and no preflight or target execution.
Controls retain exact owner/run/contract checks and positive alias/short-path discrimination without timeout inflation or skipped assertions.
